name: Singapore Institute of Technology
description: The Singapore Institute of Technology is a public university established in 2009 and granted Autonomous University status in 2014, with its main campus in Punggol. It offers applied, industry-focused degrees in engineering, health sciences, infocomm technology, business and design, including programmes run with overseas partner universities.
whyIncluded: One of Singapore's Ministry of Education (MOE)-funded Autonomous Universities, and the main local applied-degree pathway for polytechnic graduates who would otherwise consider overseas study.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition plus compulsory fees, fixed for your intake. Citizens and PRs pay the Ministry of Education (MOE) Tuition Grant rate; the international rate includes 9% GST.
programmes.notes: SIT charges per credit, fixed for the AY2026 intake cohort: SC S$131.00, PR S$225.00, international (non-ASEAN, MOE Tuition Grant) S$371.69 per credit (ASEAN S$324.82; non-subsidised S$575.52). Annual figure = per-credit fee x 60 credits (240-credit, 4-year programme). SC/PR fees exclude GST (subsidised by MOE); international fees include 9% GST. 2025 history: AY2025 schedule (SC S$130.00, PR S$225.00, IS S$371.69 per credit). 2024 history from the AY2024 schedule (SC S$127.50, PR S$225.00, IS S$366.24 per credit). Compulsory fees = AY2026 miscellaneous fees of S$88.50 per trimester (SC/PR) or S$121.70 per trimester (international), both incl. 9% GST, x 3 trimesters a year (full-time programme rate on SIT's undergraduate tuition-fees page, read via a reader proxy on 2026-10-01 because the HTML is bot-protected); the fee schedule PDF itself lists tuition only. History rows carry tuition only; the current miscellaneous fee is applied to them. Second sweep 2026-10-06: AY2024 and AY2025 miscellaneous fees found, so the 2024/2025 rows now carry them (tuition unchanged from the AY2024/AY2025 schedules). Source: SIT's official undergraduate tuition-fees page singaporetech.edu.sg/admissions/undergraduate/tuition-fees, 'Miscellaneous Fees' table, 'FULL-TIME PROGRAMMES' column ('Full-time programme rates apply to students in the Undergraduate degrees, except for the CSM Pathway'): Singapore Citizens S$80.00 / S$87.20 incl 9% GST, Singapore PRs S$80.00 / S$87.20, International Students S$110.00 / S$119.90 per trimester. AY2024: Common Crawl capture 2024-08-13 (CC-MAIN-2024-33) and 2024-12-05 (CC-MAIN-2024-51); SIT's CSM tuition-fees page captures of 2024-07-24 and 2024-10-03 label the identical non-full-time column (S$49.05 / S$76.30) 'AY2024 TRIMESTER RATE', confirming the table is the AY2024 schedule. AY2025: Wayback captures of the same page 20251204083621 and 20260303100759 (inside AY2025, Sep 2025-Aug 2026) show the same S$87.20 / S$119.90; the page changed to S$88.50 / S$121.70 only in the AY2026 capture 20260815015125. Annual = per-trimester rate incl. GST x 3 trimesters: SC/PR 87.20 x 3 = S$261.60; international 119.90 x 3 = S$359.70.
